title: Debug mode enabled (ruby) — review required
description: Debug behavior is switched on in ruby: consider_all_requests_locals*=s*true. Debug modes expose tracebacks, consoles, or verbose errors to whoever can reach the service. This lexical rule flags the switch; the reviewer confirms it is local-only or turns it off.
remediation: Gate the switch on Rails.env.development? and default it off.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the switch regardless of environment. Generic debug=true forms are separate rules.
